name: justitia-ai-platform
description: AI Legal Assistant & Equal Access Platform natively built on Google Cloud & Gemini 1.5 Pro

scripts.install:all: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), { execSync } = require('child_process'); const dir = fs.existsSync('frontend') ? 'frontend' : '.'; execSync('npm install', { cwd: dir, stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), { execSync } = require('child_process'); const dir = fs.existsSync('frontend') ? 'frontend' : '.'; execSync('npm install && npm run build', { cwd: dir, stdio: 'inherit' }); if (fs.existsSync('frontend/dist') && !fs.existsSync('dist')) { fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); }"
scripts.preview: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), { execSync } = require('child_process'); const dir = fs.existsSync('frontend') ? 'frontend' : '.'; execSync('npm run preview', { cwd: dir, stdio: 'inherit' });"
